top_signals.title: Global Stocks Climb as AI Trade Rebounds
top_signals.summary:
Stocks rose as investors in Europe and Asia tracked a comeback in technology shares on Wall Street, with days of sharp swings likely to give way to thin holiday trading. Europe’s Stoxx 600 jumped as much as 1.7%, with gains following late-session dip buying in the US that pulled the Nasdaq 100 back from the brink of a bear market ahead of Thanksgiving.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
